auth_api: Mock implementation of doc/01-authentication.md; no live OTP sent
checks: Request OTP stores challenge id, expiry and phone; does not require data.otp in production
Optional data.otp is surfaced only when the API returns it for local/testing
Invalid OTP 422 leaves the challenge available for correction
Valid OTP creates an opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie; Sanctum token is never returned to browser
GET auth/me, PATCH customer profile and POST logout use the server-held Bearer token
Profile completion redirects to the profile form; profile view displays name and WhatsApp number
Logout revokes backend token and removes browser session cookie
No JavaScript exceptions or unexpected console errors; 401/422 responses were expected validation/session states
